programs.title: Cultural Inheritors Ep.7
programs.desc: From ancient texts to external therapies, from herbal medicine to processing techniques, the documentary Wind in the Apricot Grove explores the world of Traditional Chinese Medicine through eight aspects. Following more than a dozen practitioners, inheritors, and innovators, it traces the history, culture, and contemporary relevance of a tradition that continues to evolve.

programs.title: My Village is a National Treasure Ep.1
programs.desc: Dingcun village in Shanxi has a deep cultural legacy borne from a long historical tradition. Yet despite its rich resources, the village remained stagnant for years, described by local scholars as “begging for food while holding a golden bowl.” Now, Dingcun is charting a new course, developing its rural tourism by embracing its unique cultural assets.
